title: Warm Bannock Bake
description: A delicious Italian-inspired warm bannock bake filled with gooey cheese and savory flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mozzarella and parmesan cheese.
Add the chopped basil, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and Italian seasoning to the cheese mixture. Mix well.
Add the bannock cubes to the cheese mixture and toss until evenly coated.
Transfer the bannock mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the bannock is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
